c74object.name: evi_lorez
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A novel two-pole nonlinear Ladder filter
c74object.description:
evi_lorez is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_lorez.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_approx.genexpr, evi_interp.genexpr
evi_lorez is also available in MSP as: evi.lorez~.
Nonlinear 12dB TPT Lowpass with excellent modulation properties and allpass alignment. Capable of all audio rate modulation with cutoff FM-able whilst remaining stable. Resonance stays strong even in lower frequencies. The abstraction includes code which can be extracted for parameter rate control of the coefficients calculation and linear operation if required.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: in Hz @min 1 @max samplerate*0.333333. Cutoff frequency in Hz.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @min 0 @max 2. Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with a little loss in anti-aliasing.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.
